newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Policy in place for low Australian rates-govt.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Policy in place for low Australian rates-govt.

text.p: Australian Deputy Prime Minister and Trade Minister Tim Fischer said on Tuesday the government had policies in place to help lower Australian interest rates and this would pave the way for a "more accurate" exchange rate.

"The lower the interest rate structure in Australia...the better it is in terms of seeking to pave the way for a more accurate exchange rate," Fischer told reporters, after being asked whether the recent surge in the Australian dollar would harm Australia's competitiveness.
